title: GitHub source links
responsibility: Normalizes GitHub repository addresses and builds encoded file links pinned to an exact commit.

inputs.name: githubRepositoryUrl.remote
inputs.description: GitHub HTTPS or SSH remote address; other hosts and credential-bearing URLs are unsupported.

inputs.name: githubSourceUrl.repository
inputs.description: Public GitHub repository URL, or undefined when the project has none.

inputs.name: githubSourceUrl.commit
inputs.description: Full lowercase Git commit hash of the selected source revision.

inputs.name: githubSourceUrl.path
inputs.description: Repository-relative file path; each segment is encoded for the GitHub URL.

outputs.name: githubRepositoryUrl
outputs.description: A normalized https://github.com/owner/repository URL, or undefined for unsupported or credential-bearing input.

outputs.name: githubSourceUrl
outputs.description: A GitHub blob URL at a full commit hash with every path segment encoded, or undefined for unsafe repository, revision or path input.
